eyebrow.static: eyebrow authored in the Topic link (page) and Topic (text) fields; legacy content with the eyebrow as the first link of the Text field is still supported
eyebrow.dynamic: eyebrow-dynamic variant class (dynamicTopic); topic ignored, eyebrow shows the title of the authored Topic link page. A blank topic in static mode also uses that page title

capabilities.notes: content rows: image, text, topic (topicLink + topicLinkText); the topic row is merged into the card at render time. Presentation and eyebrow mode are variant classes, not content rows. Single-image cards view only; carousel/facts views are not supported

suitableFor: article highlight sections with background image
promotional banners with overlay content card
left- or right-aligned overlay content cards (align-left / align-right)
